PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_HandOperatedActuator
PropertySetDef.Definition:
Definition from IAI: This property set is used to define the characteristics of a hand-operated actuator.
HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 2.0.
ISSUES: No issues to date.

PropertyDef.Name: ManualOverride
PropertyDef.Definition: Identifies whether hand-operated operation is provided as an override
